A '''battle''' was fought in the [[Randon system/Legends|Randon system]] in [[3962 BBY]] as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. The battle took place because the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] campaigned to take control of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. Called "[[Mandalorian Triumph]]," the charge had two prongs, with one advance beginning within the [[Dernatine system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which they had [[Battle of the Dernatine system (Mandalorian Wars)|taken]] [[3963 BBY|the year before]], and continuing [[Battle of the Charros system (Mandalorian Wars)|through]] the [[Charros system/Legends|Charros system]]. This part of their Coreward advance was halted at Randon, where the Republic was able to defend the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. However, the other prong of the Mandalorian Triumph proved successful and Duro was [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|taken]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Randon system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
